title: Transparent Lava
description: This makes the lava semi-transparent for better visuals and fps.
body: ![Here is a picture of nether's under lava ravine, with some ores and other kinds of blocks exposed.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/918d16e4c0605aebd5395b6c1b71a2e74fbb32c4.png)Transparent Lava is a lightweight texture pack that reworks Minecraft’s lava to look cleaner, smoother, and slightly see-through for a better FPS and more immersive feel.
